module_source:
Meters = Type (Meters Int).
pack x = Meters x.
value (Meters x) = x.

rows.source:
unsafe base.
Map = use "std/map".
M = use "meters".
fill n m = if n <= 0 then m else fill (n - 1) (Map.insert n n m).
addValue a key value = a + value.
check n = m = fill n Map.ints; a = Map.fold addValue 0 m; Map.fold addValue a m.
main = print (check 512).
